comment: Operator registry for durable event streams. Stored at the repo root outside the statically served world/ tree. Redis Streams uses a consumer group and XACK; SQS uses visibility timeouts and DeleteMessage. Reads do not acknowledge. Prefer url_env over a literal url when the Redis URL contains a password. Backends are optional: add only the streams you actually operate, and set enabled true after the credentials and target exist.

redis_events.name: Redis Streams events
redis_events.description: Example durable Redis Streams consumer. Enable after setting REDIS_EVENTS_URL and creating the stream.

sqs_events.name: AWS SQS events
sqs_events.description: Example durable SQS consumer. Enable after setting standard AWS credentials and the queue URL.
